title: OdFlowAggregated
description: Journey counts between two grid cells over a period. The analytical counterpart to journey-completed: linkage is performed inside transit-core before publication and does not survive into the aggregate. Coarse geo only, and a floor on `journeys` so a flow cannot describe one traveller.

period_start.description: Start of the aggregation period, inclusive.

period_end.description: End of the aggregation period, exclusive.

journeys.description: Journeys observed between the two cells. Floored at 5 so an origin-destination pair cannot describe a single traveller.

mode.description: Predominant mode of the flow. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
